fields.label: Principal Code
fields.description: Must match the principal code in the distributors' rules; batches for any other principal are refused.

fields.label: Allowed Clock Skew (seconds)
fields.description: Signed requests older or newer than this are refused (replay protection).

fields.label: Hold Data Until Consent Is Recorded
fields.description: Data from a distributor without a Data Sharing Consent Date is not accepted yet. Its agent keeps it and retries, so nothing is lost once the date is entered.

fields.label: Wording
fields.description: A distributor's own site receives data from its dealers: set Dealer and Customer here and press Apply Wording. Every screen and report of this app then uses those words.

fields.label: Those Who Send Data
fields.description: Distributor on a manufacturer's site; Dealer on a distributor's site

fields.label: Their Buyers
fields.description: Retailer on a manufacturer's site; Customer on a distributor's site

fields.label: Send Alerts To
fields.description: E-mail addresses, one per line or comma-separated. Empty = no alert e-mails.

fields.label: Show Cost And Margin In Reports
fields.description: Cost is estimated from the distributor's stock valuation already synced. Shown only for distributors who consented (SSV Distributor → Shares Cost Price).

fields.label: Agent updates
fields.description: Agents running as the Windows service install this version by themselves, checking the checksum first, and go back to the previous version if the new one keeps failing.

fields.label: Approved Agent Version
fields.description: e.g. 0.4.2. Agents older than this update; leave empty to stop updates.

fields.label: Agent Download URL
fields.description: HTTPS address of ssv-agent.exe for that version, e.g. a file attached here with Is Private unticked.

fields.label: Agent SHA-256
fields.description: Checksum of that ssv-agent.exe (PowerShell: Get-FileHash ssv-agent.exe). An agent refuses a download that does not match.
